Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but ion storm formations in ELECTRIC VIOLET and CYAN glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course.
